headline: TEX @ MIA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 4.02 at MIA 4.96, with a projected total of 8.98. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: TEX moved +0.09 runs while MIA moved +1.00, changing the projected margin by -0.91 runs. The projected total climbed +1.09, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -18.3%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Cal Quantrill has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Wyatt Langford, Otto Lopez, Brandon Nimmo, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Justin Foscue because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
